resources.string: Tap Parking in Verona to see the spaces reported by AMT3, including at Tribunale, Centro and the station. A gray P means there is no reliable recent count.
Take a look before you go
Tap a pin, then pull up the handle to see details, photos and visitor reviews when available. Pull down to return to the map. Your route only changes if you pick a destination or add a stop.
Tap Parking below the search bar to see reported free spaces. Tap a pin, then the heart to save it. Next time, check the count right in Favorites.
Your usual places, one tap away
Save Home or Work in a destination’s details. Open search to find them alongside your recently sent places, or tap the microphone to dictate a new one on supported phones.
